questions.q: Let $R$ be the set of all real numbers and $f: R \to R$ be a continuous function. Suppose $| f ( x ) - f ( y ) | \ge | x - y |$ for all real numbers $x$ and $y.$ Then
options: $f$ is one-one, but need not be onto
$f$ is onto, but need not be one-one
$f$ need not be either one-one or onto
questions.solution:
Let $f ( x ) = f ( y )$
So, $| f ( x ) - f ( y ) | \ge | x - y |$
$⇒ 0 \ge | x - y | ⇒ x - y = 0 ⇒ x = y$
$⇒ f$ is one-one
Since, $f$ is continuous
So $f ( 0 )$ is finite Now, $| f ( x ) - f ( 0 ) | \ge | x - 0 |$
$⇒ \lim_{x \to \infty} | f ( x ) - f ( 0 ) | \ge \lim_{x \to \infty} | x |$
$⇒ \lim_{x \to \infty}f ( x ) = \infty$
$⇒ f$ is unbounded
$⇒ f$ is surjective

questions.q: What is the probability that a human individual would receive the entire haploid set of chromosomes from his/her grandfather?
questions.solution:
Human's shows XX-XY type of sex determination, where females are homogametic and males are heterogametic.

An organism has& $23$ chromosomes from its father and $23$~from his mother. Since& there is a& $50 %$ chance of getting paternal grandmother's chromosome~for each of the& $23$~chromosome& in the cell, the probability of getting every one of the& $23$~chromosome& from one grandparent, is $\left(0 . 5\right)23 or \left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)23$ or~$1$ in~$8$ million.

II. $f$ is an even function.

$

Given function $f: R ⟶ R$ be a continuous function such that $f \left(x^{2}\right) = f \left(x^{3}\right) ∀ x \in R$

then f $\left(x\right) = f\left(x^{23}\right)$ [on replacing $x$ by$x^{1 / 3}$]

Similarly,$

$= f \left(x^{0}\right) [as $x$ tends to infinity] $= f $\left(1\right)$

$∴ $f$\left(x\right)$ = f $\left(1\right)$ =$ constant$

The function f $\left(x\right)$ =constant$ is even and differentiable everywhere.
